target_release: the release declared by the consumer project
dependencies: sf-m3[pytest] installed in the consumer project's Python environment

assertions: stdio server receives the M3_DEMO_SERVICE_KEY value as DEMO_SERVICE_TOKEN
tool call returns the expected text and structured authenticated result

network: No external network. The SDK starts the local stdio MCP server.
credentials: The test creates a fixed dummy value; it is not a provider credential.
cleanup: The async client kit closes its stdio child; pytest restores the environment.
